key.name: open-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the launcher

key.name: bitwarden-enabled
key.summary: Search Bitwarden through rbw

key.name: rbw-path
key.summary: Path to the rbw binary

key.name: rbw-pinentry-bridge
key.summary: Answer rbw's master password prompt in the launcher
key.description: Set by the preferences, which also point rbw's pinentry at the bridge script.

key.name: rbw-pinentry-fallback
key.summary: rbw's pinentry before the bridge was enabled; restored when it's disabled

key.name: onepassword-enabled
key.summary: Search 1Password through the op CLI

key.name: op-path
key.summary: Path to the 1Password CLI

key.name: onepassword-account
key.summary: 1Password account (shorthand, sign-in address or ID); empty for the default

key.name: onepassword-unlock
key.summary: How to unlock 1Password: the desktop app, the master password in the launcher, or auto

key.name: clear-clipboard-seconds
key.summary: Clear copied secrets after this many seconds (0 = never)

key.name: scrub-clipboard-history
key.summary: Remove copied secrets from Clipboard Indicator's history

key.name: type-delay-ms
key.summary: Delay between typed characters in milliseconds

key.name: browser-login
key.summary: Enter on an item with a website opens it and fills the login through the browser extension

key.name: bitwarden-autofill-keys
key.summary: The Bitwarden browser extension's "Autofill login" shortcut; empty = only open the website

key.name: onepassword-autofill-keys
key.summary: The 1Password browser extension's autofill shortcut; empty = only open the website

key.name: autofill-delay-ms
key.summary: How long the website gets to load before its login is filled

key.name: submit-after-password
key.summary: Press Enter after typing a password

key.name: launcher-shortcuts
key.summary: Shortcuts inside the launcher that differ from the defaults
key.description: Maps a shortcut id (see src/lib/shortcuts.ts) to GTK accelerators; an empty list turns it off.

key.name: onboarding-done
key.summary: Getting Started was shown; until then the launcher opens with it

key.name: recent
key.summary: Recently used items, newest first

key.name: default-currency
key.summary: Currency that amounts like "100 usd" are converted to

key.name: t3code-enabled
key.summary: Search active T3 Code sessions (when T3 Code is installed)

key.name: t3code-data-dir
key.summary: T3 Code data directory; empty for ~/.t3/userdata

key.name: clockify-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the launcher straight in Clockify (optional)

key.name: clockify-api-key
key.summary: Clockify API key

key.name: clockify-api-url
key.summary: Clockify API base URL (regional servers use e.g. https://euc1.clockify.me/api/v1)
